title: SQLite Persistence & Parameterized Queries Guidelines
keyTechniques: Always use parameterized queries (db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(id)) to prevent SQL injection
Use SQLite WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) mode (PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;) for higher concurrency
Wrap multi-step database mutations inside explicit transactions to maintain data integrity
avoid: Do not concatenate raw user input strings directly into SQL query statements
Do not keep unclosed database connections hanging in request handlers
